name: dignity.js
description: REST-like object API over peer-to-peer replication with CQRS read replicas, Dignity Apps, and verification policies

lifecycle.start: attach network message handler and begin receiving
lifecycle.stop: leave discovery scopes and detach handler

options.connectToPeers: optional; defaults to collaborators on PeerJS mesh
options.peerGroupId: optional; auto-publish signed domain event to this PeerGroup (v0.8+, publisher role)

read.returns: active record or null; see recordShape

options.expectedVersion: optional number; throws VERSION_CONFLICT when mismatched
options.peerGroupId: optional; auto-publish domain event when publisher (v0.8+)

updateWithRetry.description: read-modify-write helper with automatic retry on version conflicts

pushRecordSnapshot.description: broadcast full record for late joiners who missed the initial create

getRecordPeerIds.description: returns owner + collaborator peer ids for connectToPeers

options.peerGroupId: optional; auto-publish domain event when publisher (v0.8+)

options.keepAsCollaborator: default true; previous owner stays collaborator

proposeUpdate.authorization: non-owner only; owner should call update()
proposeUpdate.description: signed direct proposal to record owner (#13 turn-based games)

options.connectToPeers: ensure connection to owner before send

acceptProposal.description: validate and apply proposal patch via update(); sends proposal:result to proposer

rejectProposal.description: reject without applying patch; sends proposal:result to proposer

registerVerification.description: local collection rules; embeds verificationHash/verificationVersion on operations and snapshots (#115–#117)

options.code: string, object, or function business rules
options.reflective: when true, fingerprint nested functions via AST-canonical toString (#123)

registerPublisherVerification.method: registerPublisherVerification(publisherId, collection, { code, version?, policy?, dappId?, reflective? })
registerPublisherVerification.description: decentralized official dapp version trust keyed by publisherId (#123); no central registry

getVerificationEntry.description: returns local verification registry entry for collection, or null

getPublisherVerificationEntry.description: returns publisher-scoped verification entry trusted locally for that publisher + collection

resolveVerificationEntry.description: publisher entry when senderId matches a registered official publisher; otherwise local entry

restoreRecord.description: apply remote snapshot or persistence record locally; recomputes hash and runs verification ingest checks

list.returns: active records with hash; deleted stubs omit hash when includeDeleted is true

options.includeDeleted: include tombstone stubs in list results

peers.connectToPeer: open PeerJS data channel to peer id
peers.ensureConnectedToPeers: connect to many peers before broadcast
peers.joinDiscovery: scoped presence; options.bootstrapPeerIds connects before announce; advertises verification metadata when registered
peers.leaveDiscovery: stop heartbeat and remove local presence from scope
peers.listPeers: list presence entries in a discovery scope
peers.announcePresence: manual presence heartbeat for a joined scope
peers.registerPeerPublicKey: trust peer signing/encryption keys with optional generation
peers.trustPeerPublicKey: register trusted keys without generation metadata
peers.getPublicKey: returns this node's public key bundle
peers.unbanPeer: clear manual or automatic peer ban
peers.getBanInfo: returns ban expiry and reason for peerId, or null
peers.banPeer: ban peer for durationMs (default peerBanDurationMs); emits peerbanned

identity.getPeerIdentityState: public key + generation state for peerId
identity.deriveAndAdoptIdentity: derive keys from username/password and adopt
identity.broadcastColdRecoveryEnrollment: broadcast cold-recovery enrollment to peers (low-level; pair with enrollColdRecoveryPassword)
identity.enrollAndBroadcastColdRecovery: convenience: enroll cold recovery key and announce in one call

peerGroups.joinPeerGroup: join scalable gossip group; options: fanout, maxActivePeers, maxHops (default 64), role, tiered, liveCap, tierMode, domainEvents, publisherId
peerGroups.leavePeerGroup: leave gossip group and scoped presence
peerGroups.publishToPeerGroup: epidemic publish to live tier when tiered; inner types: operation, record:snapshot, domain:event, custom
peerGroups.publishPeerGroupBulk: bulk-tier publish (publisher only); batched domain events and checkpoints
peerGroups.publishPeerGroupCheckpoint: publish domain-event chain checkpoint to bulk tier
peerGroups.publishRecordToPeerGroup: publish normalized record snapshot into gossip group
peerGroups.getPeerGroupConfig: returns joined group config including tier and domainEvents flags

verification.hashVerificationCode: canonical sha512 hash of verification code + compatibility policy
verification.hashReflectiveLogic: walk object graphs with Reflect.ownKeys; AST-canonicalize nested functions before hashing (#123)
verification.normalizeFunctionSource: parse function.toString() via acorn/astring when possible; fallback whitespace strip
verification.collectReflectiveFingerprints: return { canonical, fingerprints } map of paths to normalized function sources
verification.normalizeVerificationCode: stable canonical form for functions, strings, or rule objects
verification.buildVerificationEntry: build registry entry with version-to-hash map and optional fingerprintList
verification.buildPublisherVerificationKey: stable key for publisherId + collection registry slot
verification.evaluateVerificationCompatibility: policy engine for remote hash/version acceptance on ingest
verification.buildVerificationPresenceMetadata: local verification summary for joinDiscovery presence

cqrs.DignityQueryReplica: read-only materialized view from domain events; methods: start, stop, read, list, verifyChain, getViewStats
cqrs.domainEvents: operationToDomainEvent, signDomainEvent, verifyDomainEvent, verifyEventChain, buildCheckpoint, createEmptyView, applyDomainEventToView, DOMAIN_EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION

dignityApps._intro: v0.11+ sandboxed iframe host, bridge, stored commands; verification pins in v0.13+
dignityApps.validateDignityAppManifest: validate manifest; returns { ok, manifest | reason }; supports dappVersion, logicHash, publisherId, storedLogic (#123)
dignityApps.getStoredCommand: lookup pre-declared stored command by id
dignityApps.buildAppCsp: build immutable CSP content from manifest allowedCspOrigins
dignityApps.prepareSandboxedAppHtml: inject CSP meta and violation reporter into app HTML
dignityApps.injectCspMeta: prepend CSP meta tag to HTML head
dignityApps.DignityAppHost: sandboxed iframe host; mount(container, html), unmount(), rpc() for tests
dignityApps.createHostRpcHandler: MessageChannel RPC: ready, query, list, runStoredCommand, log, error
dignityApps.createDignityAppClient: app-side SDK bound to transferred MessagePort
dignityApps.connectDignityAppClient: wait for parent handshake postMessage in iframe
dignityApps.buildClientBootstrapScript: self-contained iframe bootstrap; auto-captures console.error, onerror, unhandledrejection (#106)
dignityApps.HANDSHAKE_TYPE: postMessage type string for parent ↔ iframe port transfer
dignityApps.attachErrorPanel: host DOM error/log panel; subscribes to applog, apperror, apprpcerror (#106)
dignityApps.sanitizeCaptureMessage: cap and sanitize forwarded log/error strings
dignityApps.sanitizeCaptureValue: redact sensitive keys in forwarded capture payloads
dignityApps.executeStoredCommand: run manifest-declared write on publisher node; enforces publisher verification when manifest pins logic (#123)
dignityApps.isPublisherCommandCapable: true when attached node can execute stored commands

network.InMemoryNetworkHub: test/local hub wiring multiple InMemoryNetworkAdapter instances
network.InMemoryNetworkAdapter: synchronous in-process transport for unit tests
network.createPeerJSNetworkAdapter: factory; options: urls, iceServers, peerOptions, maxOpenConnections

packageExports.security: VDF, SlothPermutation, MessageSecurityService, DEFAULT_SECURITY_OPTIONS, DEFAULT_APP_PASSWORD, deriveKeyPairFromCredentials, deriveColdRecoverySigningKey, keyPairToPublicBundle
packageExports.identity: createIdentityRotation, verifyIdentityRotation, revokeAndRotateIdentity, rotateIdentityPassword, enrollColdRecoveryPassword, verifyColdRecoveryEnrollment, shouldApplyIdentityRotation

events.warning: see warningSubtypes; emitted for non-fatal issues
events.domainevent: signed domain event applied or emitted locally
events.chainbroken: domain event hash chain verification failed
events.bulkrelaychanged: bulk relay peer set changed for a tiered group
events.peergroupmessage: raw inner message received on a joined PeerGroup (used by DignityQueryReplica)
events.identityrotated: local or remote identity rotation applied
events.proposal: owner received signed update proposal from non-owner (#13)
events.proposalresult: proposer received accept/reject result for a proposal (#13)
events.verificationmismatch: remote verificationHash differs from local registry (#115); advisory unless policy is strict
events.policyrejected: operation/snapshot/event rejected by compatibility policy or untrusted publisher (#117, #123)
events.securityerror: signature, PoW, or decrypt failure on incoming message
events.messageignored: message dropped (wrong target, banned peer, etc.)

warningSubtypes.orphan-operation: remote update/delete before local record exists
warningSubtypes.content-hash-mismatch: remote record hash differs from local recompute
warningSubtypes.content-hash-missing: record missing hash field on ingest
warningSubtypes.domain-event-rejected: domain event failed verification or policy
warningSubtypes.verification-version-spoof: remote claims known semver with wrong hash
warningSubtypes.verification-hash-missing: remote write missing verificationHash when required
warningSubtypes.stored-command-rejected: stored command failed validation or verification
warningSubtypes.default-app-password: node started with default app password sentinel

queryReplicaEvents.started: replica began listening for domain events

dignityAppHostEvents.ready: sandboxed app completed ready RPC handshake
dignityAppHostEvents.apperror: error RPC or CSP securitypolicyviolation forwarded from iframe

active.hash: sha512:<hex>; computed from canonicalized data only
active.verificationHash: optional; present when collection has registerVerification (#115)

notes: hash uses stableStringify(data) so object key order does not change the digest
restoreRecord recomputes hash locally and emits warning.type=content-hash-mismatch on mismatch
remote ingest runs checkVerificationOnIngest against local or publisher-scoped registry

optional.peerGroupId: CQRS publisher group for stored commands
optional.storedLogic: map of logicRef → { version, hash, validate? }
optional.allowedCspOrigins: https origins allowed in iframe connect-src
optional.forwardConsoleLog: forward iframe console.log to host applog events

notes: dappVersion and logicHash must be set together
stored command logic pins are enforced against registerPublisherVerification on the host publisher node

broadcast.encryption: AES secretbox with PBKDF2-SHA256 derived key
broadcast.legacyKdf: single-hash fallback accepted for older peers

direct.encryption: NaCl box (X25519 + XSalsa20-Poly1305) to recipient public key
